top_signals.title: Is Technological Sovereignty Possible?
top_signals.summary: Chuck Robbins, Chair & CEO, Cisco and Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw, Union Minister of Railways, Information & Broadcasting and Electronics & Information Technology, Republic of India discuss how countries can strengthen control over critical technologies while maintaining access to the global technology ecosystem with Bloomberg's Haslinda Amin at the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: UK Water Firms Face £107 Million Hit to Bills for Unmet Targets
top_signals.summary: UK water customers should see a drop in their bills next year as the industry regulator continues to crack down on utilities that miss performance targets.

top_signals.title: U.K. and Indian economies set to overtake Japan, IMF says
top_signals.summary: A weak yen and rising costs for Japanese households have India and the U.K. on course to overtake Japan in GDP next year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: What happens to your information after a data breach
top_signals.summary: Often simultaneously, hackers start putting the data they have stolen to use while companies investigate the breach.
